detail.longDescription: It's been a while since I worked on Duplik ( https:// codeberg.org/hgrsd/duplik ), but today I picked it back up and implemented CSV as one of the output options! Fans of tabular duplicates data, rejoice. Not a particularly tricky feature to implement, but good to ease back into development on the project. The hardest part was figuring out when we were done printing and should forego a final newline 😄 # opensource # tech # software # coding # programming # zig # ziglang
